warnings.label: Carmarthenshire coast
warnings.message: There is a risk of flooding as a result of the combination of the high tides and weather conditions for the evening of Sunday 30th August 2026. Flooding of low-lying land and roads is expected. High tide is predicted to occur at Milford Haven at 8:30pm on Sunday 30th August 2026. Be careful on beaches, coastal footpaths, roads, low lying landand close to the estuary. We will continue to monitor the situation.
